The '''Starweird Queen''' was the ruler of the mysterious space-born race of the [[Starweird/Legends|starweird]]. She was considered legendary until the [[Great Galactic War]] when she attacked the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xerender]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wyellett]] defeated her.
